SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT PLANT, RENO, RESEQ FROM ERPDB.KEPRE WHERE IFFLAG = '0'
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'SNTD' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, PLANT AS PLANT, PLANT AS REF_IF_NO, RENO AS QUOTATION_NO, RESEQ AS QUOTATION_SEQ, STATUS AS STATUS, ADDDTE AS ADD_DATE, RDDATE AS RD_DATE, ITEMNO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, ITEMDE AS DESCRIPTION, ITEMSP AS SPECIFICATION, UNIT AS UNIT_MEASURE, MAKER AS MAKER_NAME, SPRICE AS PREV_UNIT_PRICE, TPRICE AS TPRICE, PURID AS ADD_USER_ID, REQNME AS REQ_USER_NAME, REQDPT AS REQ_USER_DEPT, REQTEL AS REQ_USER_TEL, ITMQTY AS ITEM_QTY, IFDATE AS LOAD_DATE, IFTIME AS LOAD_TIME, REMARK AS REMARK FROM ERPDB.KEPRE WHERE PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND RENO = '$G_RS.RENO$' AND RESEQ = '$G_RS.RESEQ$' AND IFFLAG = '0' ORDER BY PLANT, RENO, RESEQ
UPDATE ERPDB.KEPRE SET IFFLAG = '1', RSTG = '3494', RSTGNM= '코리아이플랫폼(주)' WHERE PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND RENO = '$G_RS.RENO$' AND RESEQ = '$G_RS.RESEQ$' AND IFFLAG = '0'
UPDATE ERPDB.KEPRE SET IFFLAG = '0', RSTG = '3494', RSTGNM= '코리아이플랫폼(주)' WHERE PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND RENO = '$G_RS.RENO$' AND RESEQ = '$G_RS.RESEQ$' AND IFFLAG = '0'
